}}'''Chiarid''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Maiden of the Spear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Chiarid}} She often makes jokes of [[Rand al'Thor]] and thinks of him as an younger brother.

== Appearance ==
She is old enough to be Rand's mother and has blond hair.

== Activities ==
She is part of Rand's escort when he [[Travel]]s to [[Caemlyn]].
